segments.name: Precision Oncology
segments.description: Provides blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics to clinicians, patients and biopharmaceutical companies across cancer screening, monitoring and therapy selection.
segments.evidence: We also offer the Guardant360 Tissue test for advanced-stage cancer and the Guardant Reveal test to detect residual and recurring disease in early-stage colorectal, breast and lung cancer patients.

revenueModel.text: Commercial and government payers reimburse the company's blood and tissue tests, which are also provided to biopharmaceutical companies for clinical studies and drug development.
revenueModel.evidence: demonstrating improved clinical utility and health economics from use of our tests to patients, physicians and payers
